name: Mondscheinspitze
kurzbeschreibung: The Mondscheinspitze (2,106 m) in the Karwendel: bold panoramic peak above Lake Achensee with Plumsjoch, ridge hike, and 360-degree summit views.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Mondscheinspitze is a prominent, 2,106-metre-high pyramid-shaped mountain in the Karwendel Range within the Tyrolean district of Schwaz. Rising along the so-called Montscheinkamm ridge between the Gerntal valley near Pertisau on Lake Achensee and the Rißtal valley in the Karwendel Nature Park, it commands an isolated, forward-projected position. As a result, the peak is celebrated as one of the finest vantage viewpoints in the Prealps: from the narrow summit ridge, a breathtaking 360-degree panorama unfolds from sparkling Lake Achensee across the Rofan Mountains and rugged Karwendel spires all the way to the glaciated Zillertal Alps.

Mountaineering Routes & Nature Experience

The name of the peak likely derives not from the moon, but from the Old High German word "Montischein" (rooted in "mons", meaning mountain pasture). Ascending the Mondscheinspitze demands genuine alpine experience and an absolute head for heights: the most popular trail departs from the Gernalm (1,172 m) at the head of the Gerntal above Pertisau. From there, the path climbs past the Plumsjoch saddle and the serviced Plumsjochhütte (1,630 m) onto the panoramic crest. The most thrilling section is the final west ridge: scrambling over steep limestone steps, wire-rope secured ledges, and narrow gravel bands, mountaineers navigate easy rock terrain (UIAA Grade I) to reach the wrought-iron summit cross. Alternatively, a quieter ascent winds from Schleimsalm via the Schleimssattel cirque. The protected area around the mountain provides habitat for chamois, alpine marmots, and rare flora such as edelweiss and alpine auriculas.

Visit & Arrival

The main hiking season spans from June to October (depending on snow conditions; dangerous old snowfields may linger in gullies in early summer). The mountain tour is freely accessible and completely free of charge. Walking time for ascent and descent: approx. 5 to 6 hours (covering 950 to 1,000 metres of elevation gain). Arrival by car: From Pertisau on Lake Achensee, take the Gerntal toll road (toll approx. €5.00–€7.00) to the spacious hikers' car park at Gernalm (1,172 m). By public transport: Rail (ÖBB) to Jenbach station, regional bus 4080 to Pertisau, and in summer continue with the local Achensee hikers' bus into the Gerntal.

Tips

The ascent to Mondscheinspitze is classified as a demanding red-to-black mountain tour; sturdy ankle-high boots with deep-tread soles, surefootedness, and vertigo-free confidence are mandatory. Do not attempt the tour in wet conditions or during thunderstorm warnings. After descending, the sun terrace of the Gernalm or Plumsjochhütte is ideal for sampling traditional Tyrolean Kaspressknödel.
oeffnungszeiten: Schneefrei Juni bis Okt frei zugänglich (nur bei trockener Witterung)
